newsitem.title: ESTONIA: TALLINNA FARMA TO HOLD BACK SOME OF PROFIT.
newsitem.headline: TALLINNA FARMA TO HOLD BACK SOME OF PROFIT.

text.p: Tallinna Farma, Estonia's only listed pharmaceuticials company, said on Monday that it will prospose to its shareholders to hold back some 23 million kroons of 1996's 29.6 million kroon profit.

In a statement Farma said that it will propose that 23 million kroons remains undistributed, 0.95 million kroons will be transferred to reserves and 6.7 million kroons wil be paid out as 1.5 kroons in dividends for every 10-kroon share held.
The company's audited balance sheet and results will be ready at the latest on April 2, the company said. It has already released unaudited 1996 figures.
